translation: The Suwen u痿u Lun (Discussion of Atrophy) says: Why does the treatment of atrophy take only the Yangming? It says: The Yangming is the sea of the five viscera and six bowels; it governs moistening the ancestral sinew, and the ancestral sinew governs binding the bones and benefiting the joints. The Chong vessel is the sea of the channels and vessels; it governs seeping and irrigating the valleys [between muscles], and together with the Yangming meets at the ancestral sinew and converges at Qijie, and the Yangming is its chief; they all belong to the Dai vessel and connect to the Du vessel. Therefore when the Yangming is deficient, the ancestral sinew relaxes and the Dai vessel does not draw, and therefore the feet atrophy and are not used.
